name: Tusk Mountains Avalanche
disable: Three DC 34 Crafting check or DC 34 Engineering-lore check (expert) to create cover for a 10-foot square area and shelter from the avalanche; a flying creature can attempt a DC 29 Acrobatics check check to Maneuver in Flight to avoid the avalanche

items.name: Cascade
items.text:
Trigger The zombie mammoth horde moves beneath the peaks

---
Effect An avalanche of snow and ice cascades down the mountainside at astonishing speed. All creatures on the ground within a 200-foot radius must attempt DC 30 Reflex save saves.

---
Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage and 4d6 cold damage.

Failure The creature is swept away, moving 200 feet down the mountainside, and takes 8d6 bludgeoning damage and 8d6 cold damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also buried, taking an additional 2d6 bludgeoning damage and then 1d6 cold damage per minute of burial. Locating a buried creature requires a DC 28 Perception check or DC 28 Survival check check; once located, a buried creature can be extricated with a DC 28 Athletics check check in one round or dug out with a DC 23 Athletics check check with 4 minutes of work.

text: Snow and ice gathered at the peaks of the mountain come crashing down in an explosive wave.
